notes:
v0.1.11 — Fixes for Claude TUI usability:
- Window can now be dragged: data-tauri-drag-region added to all titlebar children (Tauri 2 quirk — children swallow mousedown without it)
- Drag-and-drop file from Windows Explorer now converts path to /workspace/... (auto-mounted) — Claude can read the file directly. Files outside USERPROFILE auto-copied to .winmux-drops
- Ctrl+Shift+V image paste now works inside Claude TUI: window-level keydown handler in capture phase, so xterm/Claude don't swallow it
- Native paste event also routes to /workspace/.winmux-clipboard/ (was using inaccessible $INSTDIR/drops/ before)
